```python
def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    # Get grasp candidates for the object
    candidates = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
    if not candidates:
        return  # No valid grasp candidate found
    
    candidate = candidates[0]
    grasp(candidate)
    
    # Verify grasp success
    if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
        return  # Failed to grasp; abort
    
    # Get free spots on target zone
    spots = free_spots(zone_name)
    if not spots or not spots["spots"]:
        # Target zone is occupied; move the occupant first
        occupant = spots["occupants"][0]
        # Find a free spot in purple_box
        free_spots_purple = free_spots("purple_box")
        if not free_spots_purple or not free_spots_purple["spots"]:
            return  # No space to move occupant
        
        spot = free_spots_purple["spots"][0]
        carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
        lower_until_contact()
        open_gripper()
        retreat()
        wait(20)
    
    # Now place the object on the target zone
    spots = free_spots(zone_name)  # Re-check after moving occupant
    if not spots or not spots["spots"]:
        return  # Still no free spot
    
    spot = spots["spots"][0]
    carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat()
    wait(20)
```
